sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "captain"."Ship_ID" AS e, "Ship"."Class" AS g, AVG("captain"."age") AS m1 FROM "captain" JOIN "Ship" ON "Ship"."Ship_ID" = "captain"."Ship_ID"  GROUP BY "captain"."Ship_ID", "Ship"."Class"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g"), "s4" AS (SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS v FROM "s3"), "s5" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, ("s3"."m1" - "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s3"."m1" > "s4"."v") SELECT AVG("s5"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s5"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s5"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s5"
construction: agg:Ship within Ship.Class > baseline:g > baseline:all > agg:all

gap to the all average of average of captain age (all level)
